data.description:
## Why
Operator direction (2026-08-15): approach chauvinist-subsolar-arctichare (19ea-29af-ebb3-410b) as an EXPERIMENT. The auto-resume design (adolescent-evilminded-locust) re-runs the whole verifier and relies on the verdict cache to skip credited criteria; it passes NO information about WHERE the failed attempt already searched. Question to answer empirically: does handing a resumption the prior attempt's search frontier as an EXCLUSION list ("already searched, found nothing: ...") measurably reduce re-search overlap and steps-to-verdict? Blocker noted at design time: verifier telemetry does not carry argument-level tool-call transcripts — the PoC must capture them harness-side.

## Protocol (rapid PoC — throwaway harness, no production code)
1. Corpus: >=2 real CLOSED tickets with large surfaces (description near the 8000-char cap, many prose ACs/comments). Run read-only (--source local, never signs); disable/bypass the verdict cache in-harness so exhaustion is reproducible.
2. Transcript capture: wrap the verifier's tool executor in-harness (monkeypatch at the workflow seam) to log every tool call with full arguments (file paths read, grep patterns, dirs listed) per criterion.
3. Force exhaustion: run attempt 1 with a deliberately REDUCED step budget (harness override) so it FAILs insufficiency-only with a partial bank; keep the transcript.
4. Extract frontier: from the transcript, derive per-criterion searched-set (paths read, patterns tried) and a compact exclusion summary (<=1500 chars).
5. Resume two ways with the same reduced budget: (A) CONTROL — plain re-run (locust behavior: cache-seeded only; re-enable cache for both arms); (B) TREATMENT — same, plus the exclusion summary injected into the verifier prompt.
6. Metrics table (the deliverable): re-search overlap rate (tool calls in attempt 2 repeating attempt-1 arguments) A vs B, newly-banked PASSes per step A vs B, attempts-to-clean-close A vs B, token cost delta.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Harness exists in the experiment worktree (throwaway; NOT pushed to Gerrit; no src/rebar changes).
- [ ] Argument-level transcripts captured for >=2 large tickets across forced-exhaustion + both resume arms.
- [ ] Metrics table posted as a comment on THIS ticket and on chauvinist-subsolar-arctichare: overlap rate, PASS-per-step, attempts, cost.
- [ ] Verdict comment: does the exclusion list measurably beat plain cache-seeded resume? Include a go/no-go recommendation and what telemetry production would need to carry.
- [ ] No store writes beyond ticket comments; no signatures minted (--source local only).
data.title: Experiment: search-frontier exclusion-list resumption (arctichare PoC)
